correctness.rationale: From the upper-half-plane Bergman kernel -1/(π(z-conj w)^2), derivative signs fixed by Gram inner-product conjugation give B_ξ=-1/(πu²)F_ξ(1/u) with F=|ξ0|²+2(conj ξ0 ξ1-conj ξ1 ξ0)t-6|ξ1|²t². If ξ0≠0 and a=x+iy=ξ1/ξ0, then F/|ξ0|²=1+4iyt-6|a|²t², whose two roots have imaginary part y/(3|a|²). For u=z-conj w, t=1/u maps H×H ONTO the open lower half-plane (explicit inverse witnesses), hence zeros exist iff y<0. ξ0=0 gives F proportional to t², with t=0 outside the range; a=0 gives constant F. Symbolic independent root calculations for several complex a and explicit inverse witnesses checked critical branches. No extension to higher jets.
